ResetVars - Reset CombatZone speeds, soul fall speeds, etc. to default values Automatically applied by EndAttack.
RunAttack - launch an attack on csv files Never use
PlayerHeal - restores HP Param0 - number that increases HP Param1 - 1 and then erase KR together when stated
KR - apply KR Param0 - 0 to disable, 1 to enable it make KR objects are invisible, so it is better to disable them in intro and enable them after blackout
Sound - sound effect to be played Param0 - the file to be sounded, referring to the folder where the sound is stored. Param1 - Specifies the pitch of the sound.

Bone - Spawn the bone
The first symbol you enter means where you want the center of the bone to appear. If you enter "L", the center of the bone will be on the left. What is useful about this is that you can place the bone at exactly the right coordinates by simply entering the respective coordinates of the Combatzone.
Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (must be 360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color(0 for normal, 1 for blue, 2 for orange, 3 for red)
Param9 - ID Param10 - Attack visualization If Param10 is set to 1, the attack will be visible outside of the frame. If not set or set to 0, the attack will only be visible within the frame.
If you want the bones to look like Papyrus', simply set the Set Image Source to "Loaded" in the Bone action. Don't forget to set the height to 13; Sans Bone has a height of 10, while papyrus has 13.

SineBonesV - Sin bones from left and right (that of Sans' first attack). Param0 - Number of bone Param1 - Space between bones (BoneRepeat reference) Param2 - Speed Param3 - Location between the bones (top longer or bottom longer) Param4 - Size between bones Param5 - Sin sway width (default value 28) Param6 - The smoothness (?) of the sinusoid (default 180) Param7 - Color Param8 - ID Param9 - Rotation speed of upper bone Param10 - Initial angle of upper bone Param11 - Rotation speed of lower bone Param12 - Initial angle of the lower bone
About Space between bones Negative values here indicate left-to-right orientation, while positive values indicate left-to-right orientation.

SineBonesH - is Sin bones from above and below (that of the first attack of Sans). Usage is the same as SineBonesV
About the space between bones If the value here is minus, it is from top to bottom, and if it is plus, it is from bottom to top.

WaveBones - Multiple BoneWB appearances
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Bone Count Param9 - Bone Space Param10 - Color Param11 - ID Param12 - Interval (Set the interval; 2.4, 4.8, 3.6, etc. are recommended.) Param13 - Strengh (10 or more is recommended.) Param14 - Timer (Change the initial length, but basic 0 is fine.) Param15 - TimerInterval (To make it look like a wave when you want more than one to appear, change this number. The larger the number, the steeper the flow of the wave.)

BoneC (Bone Circle) - makes a circular bone appear
Param0 - Bone count Param1 - Center X of Circle Param2 - Center Y of Circle Param3 - Set Bone Width Param4 - Basic angle of the bone (Circle is formed based on this angle) Param5 - Circle Moving Speed Param6 - Scale X of Circle Param7 - Scale Y of Circle Param8 - Set Bone Color Param9 - Set Bone ID
The value of the number of bone IDs set based on this ID is increased. If more than one BoneC is to appear, the second ID must be set to an ID number higher than the number of bones in the first ID, or the ID values will be duplicated.

BoneCScale - changes the size of an circle Param0 - ID of the Circle you want to change Param1 - Bone Count + ID Param2 - Final change value of ScaleX Param3 - Final change value of ScaleY Param4 - How much time to change to those values Param5 - If 1 is indicated, Circle is Destroyed after the change is completed Param6 - Set Easing ID(Required when easing two or more Circles. Each must be set to a different number to function properly)

BoneRepeat Param0 - Specifies the bone center (see normal Bone usage) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if no rotation is desired) Param8 - Number of bones Param9 - space between bones Param10 - Color Param11 - ID Param12 - 1 to make the attack visible outside of the frame Note: This will make all the bones appear at once instead of gradually, so entering too large a number of bones may make the game laggy.

BoneSC(BoneSpeedChange) - Bone appearance + speed switch Bones return after a certain time.
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color Param9 - ID Param10 - Wait time (wait for the number of seconds specified here, minus speed) Param11 - Minus speed (specifies the speed to be minus) (see ds_attack10 for reference attack) Param12 - Set speed to finish minus speed)

BoneSL(Bone Smooth Lerp) Smoothly shrinks/expands bones with lerp completion
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color Param9 - ID Param10 - Wait time (Waiting time to start shrinking/expanding) Param11 - Speed (Speed at which to zoom in/out. (0.1 or less would be desirable) Param12 - TrueWidth (The length of the bone you want to final set)

BoneCC(BoneColorChange) - Change the color of the bones along the way.
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color Param9 - ID Param10 - Wait time (wait for the number of seconds specified here, minus speed) Param11 - Bone's New Color (0,1,2,3)

BoneHY(Bone Hybrid) Hybrid of SC and SL
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color Param9 - ID Param10 - SL enable switch (write 1 to enable SL) Param11 - Wait time (Waiting time to start shrinking/expanding) Param12 - Speed (Speed at which to zoom in/out. (0.1 or less would be desirable) Param13 - TrueWidth (The length of the bone you want to final set) Param14 - SC enable switch (write 1 to enable SC) Param15 - Wait time (wait for the number of seconds specified here, minus speed) Param16- Minus speed (specifies the speed to be minus) (see ds_attack10 for reference attack) Param17- Set speed to finish minus speed) Param18 - CC enable switch (write 1 to enable CC) Param19 - Wait time (wait for the number of seconds specified here, minus speed) Param20 - Bone's New Color (0,1,2,3)

BoneWB(BoneWave) - Smoothly change the length of the bone with the sin function
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color Param9 - ID Param10 - Interval (Set the interval; 2.4, 4.8, 3.6, etc. are recommended.) Param11 - Strengh (10 or more is recommended.) Param12 - Timer (Change the initial length, but basic 0 is fine.)

BoneRW(BoneRepeatWidth) - Repeatedly expands and contracts between specified Widths in a linear motion.
Param0 - Bone placement mode (see Bone description) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Length Param4 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param5 - Direction (360 degrees) Param6 - Speed Param7 - Rotation speed (0 if you don't want rotation) Param8 - Color Param9 - ID Param10 - Max Width Param11 - Minimum Width Param12 - Speed Param13 - Step (1 or 2 changes the vertical direction)

BoneB(Bone Bomb) - Exploding bones
Param0 - X coordinate Param1 - Y coordinate Param2 - warning time to detonation (seconds) Param3 - Number of bones that will appear when exploding Param4 - Set Width Param5 - Explosion range of the bone (200 is normal)
Slash - Dusttrust Phase2 slash attack Param0 - Size (currently only 0 works) Param1 - X coordinate Param2 - Y coordinate Param3 - Angle Param4 - Wait time Param5 - color Param6 - ID

GasterBlaster Param0 - size (0 for small, 1 for normal, 2 for large, 3 for extra-large, 4 for medium, 5 for extra-large) Param1 - Initial X Param2 - Initial Y Param3 - Placement X Param4 - Placement Y Param5 - Placement angle Param6 - Wait time Param7 - Firing duration Param8 - Color (0 for normal, 1 for blue, 2 for orange, 3 for red) Param9 - ID

Platform - Spawn the platform
Param0 - X coordinate Param1 - Y coordinate Param2 - Length Param3 - Angle (default angle is horizontal) Param4 - Direction (must be 360 degrees) Param5 - Speed Param6 - Color(0 for normal, 1 for pink) Param7 - ID

SansXShake - Sans swing from side to side
Param0 - Start X Param1 - Shaking Strength(Around 5 is standard) Param2 - If 0, unlocks the function that gradually increases the intensity of the shaking If 1, unlocks the function to end the shaking Param3 - If param2 is 0, this sets the value of the increment for a gradual increase in sway. If param2 is 1, set the speed (or also called number) to end the shaking(This helps with momentary swings when sans blocked attacks, etc.)

SansXShakeEnd - Ends the ongoing sans shaking
Param0 - Set the speed (or also called number) to end the shaking
SansXShakeEnd2 - Forces an end to ongoing sans shaking (X value is forced to 320 without creating shaking)
RGB

RGBShakeToggle - Toggle between smooth and random RGB effects
Param0 = 1 - Random Param0 = 2 - Smooth
Maximum RGB strength Always fixed at this value

RGBChange - Use RGBEffect
Param0 - Initial RGB strength Param1 - How fast to weaken RGB(0.25 or 0.5 is recommended)

SmoothRGBShift - Use RGBEffect with smooth
Param0 - Initial RGB strength Param1 - Time taken

SmoothSansShake - Use SansShake with smooth
Param0 - Initial SansShake strength Param1 - Time taken Param2 - Shake Speed

ScaleBeat - Beats the screen.
Param0 - Starting Scale Param1 - Speed(0.05 recommanded)

ScreenGlow - Make the screen glow.
Param0 - Start value (1~3 is recommended) Param1 - End value Param2 - Time taken
